answer: Farms clone one indoor booth. A new key must, at dawn, stand under a public 4-by-8 garden trellis hung with 12 stamped brass tags, film a 25-second left-to-right pan, and post SHA-256(tag_order || lux_decile || address) by 07:12 local official sunrise. Peers treat the municipal pyranometer feed as the mirror and reject a lux_decile off by more than one bin, or a tag_order already used in 10 days. The shoot costs 70 minutes plus 9 POA for a single-use tag kit. If fog blanks the tags or two hashes collide, the kit is void and the key waits one epoch.
